title: Automate SMEDAN & Zoho 20 Billion Digital Support Scheme in Zoho Flow #Shorts
description:
Learn how to automate the SMEDAN and Zoho 20 billion naira digital support scheme intake using Zoho Flow, AI classification, CRM, and Books in under 5 minutes.

1. Create a Zoho Form webhook trigger in Zoho Flow for applicant intake.
2. Add a Zoho Flow AI step to classify applicant business size and industry.
3. Configure actions to create the customer record in Zoho CRM and generate initial invoices in Zoho Books.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho Flow Webhook API
- endpoint: POST /api/v1/flow/webhooks/grant-intake
- scope: ZohoFlow.webhooks.ALL
- docs: Zoho Flow Webhooks Guide

Code (json) - Zoho Flow Webhook Trigger payload section:
{
  "company_name": "Trading Ltd",
  "email": "contact@example.com",
  "industry": "Retail"
}

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
